request.title: Agni, the Humble Axeman
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. This is a still for a cinematic trailer: keep the main subject centred slightly above the middle with a strong silhouette, and keep the lower third darker and uncluttered so a title can sit over it. Scene: Agni, god of fire, warmth and justice: righteous and just. A towering, broad-shouldered bearded god of living fire and cooling stone, his great axe resting humbly on one shoulder, and in his other hand a pair of golden scales blazing with judgement. Behind him, a ruined temple in the snow bursts back into flame. His expression is stern but kind. Embers rise around him and melt the snow at his feet. Warm, dominant ember-orange palette against cold blue shadows.

references.role: Appearance reference for Agni: the towering fire god with the axe. Keep his build, beard, fire and axe; ignore the man in the foreground.

request.alt: Agni, a towering bearded god of fire with an axe on his shoulder and blazing golden scales in his hand.
